[Lembar 1]
ngaran ikang tamba, tamba weteng busung, don sotong, pinang, uyah areng, inum, weteng sepet, tamba
wong mati rasa, waru gading, santen kane, adas, babakan pule, inum, tutuh irung, tamba lara
sakeng dalem, bañjar tambara, uyah areng, temuras, inum, tamba wong mati rasa, don sotong,

[Lembar 2]
|| iti tamba tiwang brahma, yeh baas basah, kunyit, uyah, inum, tamba tiwang bang, kasuna jangu,
katik cengkeh, tamba kembung, katik cengkeh, mica, inum, 1400, puput tinulat ring dina,
redite ||
paleography.indonesian_translation:
[Lembar 1]
Nama obat tersebut: obat perut busung (bengkak berair), daun jambu biji (sotong), buah pinang, dan garam arang, diminum. Untuk perut sepet atau obat orang mati rasa, gunakan waru gading, santan murni, adas, serta kulit batang pule; diminum dan diteteskan ke hidung.

Untuk mengobati rasa sakit dari dalam, gunakan banjar tambara, garam arang, dan temuras, lalu diminum. Obat bagi orang yang mati rasa lainnya menggunakan daun jambu biji (sotong).

[Lembar 2]
Inilah obat tiwang brahma: air beras basah, kunyit, dan garam, lalu diminum. Obat tiwang merah (bang) menggunakan bawang putih dan jangu.

Obat untuk perut kembung menggunakan tangkai cengkeh dan lada, kemudian diminum. Selesai disalin pada tahun 1400 Saka pada hari Minggu (Redite).
paleography.english_translation:
[Lembar 1]
The name of the remedy: remedy for dropsy/abdominal distension (weteng busung), guava leaves (don sotong), areca nut, and charcoal salt, taken as a drink. For abdominal tightness or loss of sensation, use yellow hibiscus (waru gading), pure coconut milk, fennel, and pule bark; taken orally and administered as nasal drops.

For internal affliction, use banjar tambara, charcoal salt, and temuras, taken as a drink. Another remedy for numbness/loss of sensation uses guava leaves (don sotong).

[Lembar 2]
This is the remedy for tiwang brahma: wet rice water, turmeric, and salt, taken as a drink. Remedy for red tiwang uses garlic and acorus.

Remedy for abdominal bloating uses clove stems and black pepper, taken as a drink. Colophon notes completion in Saka year 1400 on a Sunday (Redite).

[Lembar 2]

puput pinuja ring dina tulus, mangke puput, tlas, 1800, puput tinulis

paleography.indonesian_translation:
[Lembar 1]
Ini adalah penawar sakit yang masuk ke dalam tubuh tatkala nafas atau tenaga tidak menentu. Apabila terjadi panas dalam, tandanya dapat diketahui dengan saksama.

Jika terkena tiwang dalem, obat penawarnya adalah babakan kulit kayu kaliasem dicampur garam hangat, lalu diminum sebagai loloh. Terdapat pula ramuan penawar tiwang dalem lainnya menggunakan daun sirih.

[Lembar 2]
Obat tiwang pamali menggunakan babakan kulit kayu turi bersama masui dan garam arang, kemudian diminum.

Selesai disucikan atau dituliskan pada hari baik, bertarikh tahun saka atau penanggalan tertentu, telah tamat ditulis.
paleography.english_translation:
[Lembar 1]
This is the remedy for internal ailments when internal energy is disordered. If there is internal fever, its symptoms can be observed.

For internal tiwang afflictions, the medicine consists of the bark of the kaliasem tree mixed with warm salt, then drunk as a potion. Another remedy for tiwang dalem involves sirih leaves.

[Lembar 2]
The treatment for tiwang pamali uses the bark of the turi tree, masui, and charcoal salt, then consumed.

Completed and consecrated on an auspicious day, finished writing in the indicated year.

iti tamban tuju panastis, sarana, don intaran, uyah areng, rāpoh kani, don

[Lembar 2]
|| tamba tiwang bang, sarana don sirih matemu ruas, madu, inumakna || tamba sungkan wetu
ndah pūrnna, tēlas || titiang manurat ring sasih kapat, i saka 1900, mangda sida purna ||

paleography.indonesian_translation:
[Lembar 1]
Inilah obat untuk sakit encok panas dingin. Sarananya adalah daun intaran dan garam arang, dihaluskan kemudian dibalurkan.

Obat untuk sakit perut, sarananya menggunakan kulit kayu pule (pulai) dan bawang putih, dicampur air suci/bersih lalu diminum. Obat encok lainnya menggunakan kulit kayu kaliasem dan garam uku.

[Lembar 2]
Obat tiwang merah menggunakan daun sirih yang uratnya bertemu dan madu, kemudian diminum.

Demikianlah pengobatan hingga sembuh paripurna, selesai. Ditulis pada bulan keempat (Sasih Kapat), tahun Saka 1900, semoga mendapat kesempurnaan dan keselamatan.
paleography.english_translation:
[Lembar 1]
This is a remedy for rheumatic fever with alternating heat and cold. The ingredients are neem (intaran) leaves and charcoal salt, crushed and applied as a body scrub.

Remedy for stomachache uses pule (Alstonia scholaris) bark and garlic, mixed with clean water and ingested as a drink. Another remedy for rheumatism uses kaliasem bark and sea salt.

[Lembar 2]
Remedy for red tiwang convulsion uses matching-veined betel leaves and honey, to be drunk.

Thus ends the treatment toward full recovery. Inscribed in the fourth lunar month (Sasih Kapat), Saka year 1900, may it bring complete wholeness and well-being.

paleography.indonesian_translation:
[Lembar 1]
Jika terkena tiwang pamali, obatnya adalah daun jambu biji (sotong), pinang tua, garam yang dihanguskan, diulek dan diberi air cuka, lalu diminum.

Jika terkena tiwang kancing, obatnya adalah akar jambu biji, temu kunci, pinang tua, garam arang, diminum. Untuk tiwang benteh, obatnya kulit kayu jambu biji, pulasari, adas, dan asam, diminum. Jika tiwang brahma, obatnya akar kunyit,

[Lembar 2]
garam arang, diminum. Bila tiwang jampi, obatnya daun pule, bawang merah dibakar, dan garam arang, diminum.

Bila tiwang wangke, obatnya kulit kayu pule, bubuk kapur sirih, cairan tuak, lalu diminum. Jika tiwang bangke matadah, obatnya daun sirih, lempuyang (gamongan), bawang, garam arang, dihaluskan lalu diminum. Untuk tiwang karang, ramuannya menggunakan daun turi.
paleography.english_translation:
[Lembar 1]
If suffering from tiwang pamali, the remedy is guava (sotong) leaves, ripe areca nut, and charcoal salt, crushed with vinegar water and taken orally.

For lockjaw convulsion (tiwang kancing), the medicine is guava root, Chinese keys (temukunci), mature areca nut, and charcoal salt, taken orally. For tiwang benteh, the remedy is guava bark, pulasari, fennel (adas), and tamarind, taken as a drink. If suffering from tiwang brahma, the cure is turmeric root,

[Lembar 2]
charcoal salt, consumed as a beverage. For tiwang jampi, the treatment is pule leaves, roasted shallot, and charcoal salt, taken orally.

For tiwang wangke, use pule bark with slaked lime powder and palm wine, taken orally. If suffering from tiwang bangke matadah, the medicine consists of betel leaves, gamongan rhizome, shallot, and charcoal salt ground finely and ingested. For tiwang karang, the medicine uses sesbania (turi) leaves.

paleography.indonesian_translation:
[Lembar 1]
Taru pule menyatakan khasiatnya sebagai obat dengan daun berkarakter hangat yang diformulasikan sebagai boreh (balur) untuk tubuh manusia.

Taru kaliasem menjelaskan bahwa kulit kayunya berkhasiat menyembuhkan berbagai gangguan penyakit tiwang bila dicampur dengan ketumbar, masui, garam, arang, dan kapur sirih, lalu dibalurkan ke seluruh tubuh.

[Lembar 2]
Taru sotong (jambu biji) menyatakan daunnya berkarakter hangat dan berkhasiat untuk mengobati sakit perut muruk dengan cara diramu menjadi loloh (jamu minum) bersama kunyit, temu, dan sedikit garam.

Adapun taru sirih berkarakter hangat digunakan sebagai kompres (sasap) mata yang sakit dengan campuran serbuk kapur sirih, sedangkan taru asam yang berkarakter dingin dimanfaatkan daging buahnya sebagai baluran pada perut yang mulas.
paleography.english_translation:
[Lembar 1]
Taru Pule reveals its medicinal qualities, stating that its leaves possess warm energy and are suitable as an herbal body scrub (boreh).

Taru Kaliasem states that its bark is potent against convulsions and bodily shooting pains (tiwang) when prepared as a topical paste with coriander, massoia bark, charcoal salt, and slaked lime.

[Lembar 2]
Taru Sotong (guava) explains that its warm leaves treat griping abdominal upset when brewed as a drink (loloh) combined with turmeric, temu rhizome, and salt.

Taru Sirih (betel) is noted for soothing eye disorders when prepared as a compress with powdered lime, while Taru Asam (tamarind) with its cool energy provides relief for abdominal cramps through topical application.

paleography.indonesian_translation:
[Lembar 1]
Tentang khasiat dan penawar racun. Taru sotong memiliki khasiat untuk menetralkan racun (upas). Daunnya berkarakter hangat, diolah menjadi loloh dengan memeras daunnya yang dihaluskan bersama garam areng, lalu airnya diminum dan ampasnya dibalurkan pada tubuh.

Taru kaliasem berkhasiat mengatasi bisa atau racun. Bagian kulit batangnya berkarakter netral atau hangat, direbus atau digiling menjadi loloh dengan campuran sedikit adas lalu diminum.

[Lembar 2]
Taru kunyit berguna untuk mengobati racun atau panas di dalam rongga tubuh. Rimpang atau akarnya yang berkarakter hangat ditumbuk untuk dibuat minuman herbal bersama air ketumbar.

Taru turi berkarakter dingin. Bagian daunnya digunakan sebagai obat loloh dengan memerasnya menggunakan air bersih yang segar kemudian diminum.
paleography.english_translation:
[Lembar 1]
Concerning medicinal properties and antidote formulations. Taru sotong (guava) is used to counteract poison and toxins. Its leaves possess a warm energy character; the leaves are ground, mixed with charcoal salt, and prepared as a potion (loloh) to drink, while the solid residue is used as a body poultice (boreh).

Taru kaliasem is used to neutralize poison. Its bark exhibits a balanced or warm property, formulated into a drink by infusing it with a pinch of fennel (adas) and consumed.

[Lembar 2]
Taru kunyit (turmeric) is indicated for clearing internal toxins and heat. Its root or rhizome has a warm nature and is crushed and mixed with coriander water to be consumed as a medicinal beverage.

Taru turi possesses a cooling energy property. Its leaves are ground and prepared as a potable infusion (loloh) mixed with fresh water to alleviate ailment.
